entries.developer_comments:
~ NPC dialogue line
~ Simple, really.  You'll still be human on the inside.  Most of your meat
will be there.  Even a lot of your muscle and bone.  But your arms and legs
will mostly be robotic.  Your eyes, too.  You'll keep the inside parts, but
they'll be part of the armored interface.  They'll all need power to work
properly.  It'll all still work a bit without it, but it's not pleasant.
Your torso and head, and everything in them, will be integrated into the
shell itself.  Your body will keep everything going as it is now, so no
need for power there.  You'll be more sturdy, and the machines will do most
of the hard work for you, so no more worrying about getting out of breath
while running from the dead.  But that's only if you keep it powered and in
good repair.
identity: Peasey, truly.  You'll still be mostly mince, like ol' Rubik here.  Even much'a muscle n' bone.  Human inside.  But yer wiggles and wobs, that is yer limbs and digits, will be mostly steel."  Rubik motions to your eyes.  "Yer berry pies, too.  Ye'll keep the see-ey bits, but they'll be part'a the new interface.  So, arms, legs, eyes, it'll all need power to work.  They'll work without, but tassed it isn't nice."  Rubik motions to your torso and head.  "Now, yer chest n' lump, and everything in'em, will go inside the tidy bell.  Yer heart n' lungs n' all of that will keep going as it is now, no need for power.  All in all, you'll be more sturdy, n' the steel'll do the hard work for ye.  No more losin' breath on a scramble with the dead… if ye can stay powered n' in fine repair.
